blocks.title: How it works.
rows: You sell, you own the client
The pitch, the relationship and the invoice to the end client are yours. We are a line item you control.
A two-page SOW in your template, three days after the call, with our engineering estimate inside your price.
Your repo or theirs, your standup, your Slack. Our engineers appear as your team; the handover pack carries your logo.

blocks.title: What you get.
rows: An agency rate card: [YOUR RATE] less [AGENCY DISCOUNT] per day, so there is margin without padding the scope
Named senior engineers you can put in front of your client as yours
Our estimate inside your SOW, in your template, with our name nowhere on it unless you want it there
Mutual non-solicitation for twelve months, in writing
A fortnightly review with you, not with your client, unless you invite us
Capacity notice: four weeks ahead for a new engagement, ten working days for one more engineer on a running one

blocks.title: We will say no when
rows: — You want us to present as your in-house team to a client who asks directly; we will stay quiet, we will not lie
— The scope is already sold at a price that cannot carry senior people
— Your client needs us more than you do, and nobody has said so

items.q: Will you ever go around us?
items.a: No. Mutual non-solicitation is in the agreement, and if your client contacts us directly we tell you the same day and point them back to you.

items.q: Can our designers work with your engineers directly?
items.a: Yes, and it is better when they do. Figma to production is a conversation, not a handover; we have shipped design systems with product teams this way.

items.q: What if the client's scope changes under us?
items.a: It goes through you. We re-estimate inside your template, you re-price to your client, and the fortnightly review shows both of us the cost against plan.

items.q: Do you take a share of the margin?
items.a: No. You pay the agency day rate; what you charge your client is yours.

blocks.title: Bring the pitch you are about to lose on capacity.
blocks.sub: Bring the problem, not a brief. If it is outside what we do well, we will say which of our contacts to call instead.
blocks.emailLine: Or email [HELLO@HOPSIG.COM] — reply within one working day.
